messages:
alex_support: Heads up — ACME reporting 429s from their dedicated pool rp-42 since ~09:12 PST. They claim reserved capacity still available. Sample support trace attached.

julie_support: Customer says spikes started after the billing migration last night. Flagged to SRE.

marta_sre: On it. Can you paste tenant_id + the quota patch id? Any UI vs API mismatch suspected?

alex_support: tenant: tenant-acme ; patch: mig-2026-03-16-rate-units ; snippet:
```
{"tenant_id":"tenant-acme","rate_limit":{"units":1000,"denom":"minute"}}
```
customer shows 1000/min in UI but backend logs show 1000/hour.

sam_eng: Skimming the billing-converter code: looks like migration used the wrong transform. Found this in the converter: 
```
# bug: accidental division instead of multiplication
converted = units / 60  # wrong - should be units * 60 when converting from minute->hour representation in our internal denom
```

opsbot: ALERT rp-42: 429-rate 23% over 5m. Incident: INC-8792. [link]

marta_sre: That explains the effective throttling — tenant got ~60x fewer tokens than expected, plus autoscaler didn't react because reserved capacity reads returned 0 after migration sync. Looking at autoscale logs now.

sam_eng: Autoscaler log snippet: `2026-03-16T09:15:00Z scale_decision: deny (cooldown)` — we set a long cooldown during migration to avoid flapping. Means even though queue built up, scale was suppressed.

julie_support: Customer also sees tail latency increase from ~1s to ~2s in the same window. They're upset because they purchased reserved pool.

alex_support: Quick repro I ran locally: 
1) curl -H 'x-tenant: tenant-acme' https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{...}' -v
2) fire ~200 reqs/min -> 429s appear after ~30s.
I can share full traces if SRE needs them.

marta_sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback mig-2026-03-16-rate-units on billing service 2) add tenant-acme to temporary throttle whitelist for rp-42 3) shorten autoscale cooldown for reserved pools during incident. Can eng apply rollback and the whitelist?

sam_eng: Rolling back billing migration now. Kicking off hotfix PR to correct denom conversion and add unit tests + integration check. ETA ~20m.

opsbot: deploybot: rollback billing-service @commit abc123 started.

julie_support: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer that a rollback + hotfix is underway and share timelines.

alex_support: Thanks — please create a short post-incident note in #postmortems once fixed. I'll keep the support ticket open until we verify.

marta_sre: Follow-ups: add a canary for billing migrations that validates quotas for a reserved pool, add an integration test to assert denom translations, and monitor rp-42 for 1h after rollback.

sam_eng: Also adding a migration-safety check to CI that rejects conversions that reduce effective capacity by >10%.

alex_support: Great — will loop in account team to apologize and offer a short SLA credit if they want.

julie_support: Closing loop: customer acknowledged the rollback notice and is waiting for confirmation. Will post updates here.
